svg.title: Compilation handoffs: classes
svg.desc: Read from top to bottom. Provider symbols and link inputs are available before the final cubin and kernel handle.

g.aria-label: CuTe compiler. Compiler class. CuTeDSL. Trace Python with symbolic values.
cuda.coop. Plan and provider-request records. GroupLoweringPlan. _CubLoadStoreRequest / _CubScanRequest. Record the provider symbol and ABI.
cuda.coop. Session class. BundleSession. add(): keep unique requests.. add_deferred_temp_storage_event(): keep ordered uses.
CuTe compiler. Callable class. FFI.__call__(). Emit a typed external declaration and func.call.. Continue the CuTe trace.
cuda.coop. Finalization function. _trace_finalize_hook(). Take the session for this module.
cuda.coop. Renderer callback record. BundleRenderer. render_bundle_source(): emit wrappers.. bundle_scratch_layout_probes(): collect ScratchLayoutProbe records.
NVRTC. External compiler. nvrtcCompileProgram(). nvrtcGetLoweredName(): scratch layouts.. nvrtcGetLTOIR(): provider image.
cuda.coop. Result record. BundleCompilation. Retain the LTO-IR path and ScratchLayout map.
cuda.coop. Optional records and allocator class. DeferredTempStoragePlan. Bindings assign slices to calls.. SmemAllocator allocates backing memory.. Replace address and size placeholders.

CuTe compiler. Compiler class; inherited methods. CuTeDSL. generate_original_ir(): hash and build after the hook.. _merge_gpu_link_libraries(): copy paths into LinkLibraries.. compile_and_cache(): compile the kernel.
nvJitLink. External linker. nvJitLink. Resolve or inline provider symbols.. Return the linked cubin.
CuTe compiler. Compiled-function class. JitCompiledFunction. CudaModuleAndKernel retains the loaded kernel.. Launch the compiled kernel.
